question: Can the static evidence console become a useful live Base transaction verifier that cross-checks fixed server-side Base sources and renders a deterministic, honest receipt/finality verdict from only a transaction hash, without exposing arbitrary URLs or any wallet, signing, payment, retry, or action path?
startingState: Session 7 shipped a polished read-only release evidence console at canary.0x402.sh on commit 8b3ef1f. The public surface only reads static health/release DTOs, all outbound capability flags are false, and the local feature branch contains one receipt-only commit beyond production.
boundedChange: Add fixed-registry read-only Base source adapters, a sanitized network-status API and strict transaction-hash verification API, receipt-level native Base USDC EIP-3009 classification with cross-source agreement and finality, and an accessible interactive UI. Update health/release capability claims and containment tests truthfully. No caller-selected endpoint, historical block scan, wallet, signer, authorization creation, payment, transaction submission, retry/action execution, private journal/artifact exposure, Bankr mutation, duplicate Vercel project, or non-canonical deployment.
successCondition: A user can enter a canonical Base transaction hash on the live canonical site and receive a bounded verified/pending/not-found/not-native-USDC/contradiction/unavailable result with source agreement, finality, block, parties, and human USDC amount when provable; the page shows current Base source health; malformed or extra input fails closed; browser/API tests pass; preview and canonical production are exact-commit verified.
failureCondition: Any caller-controlled URL or RPC method is accepted; a single-source or contradictory observation is labeled verified; malformed receipts, non-Base chain data, removed logs, non-native USDC, or unfinalized data are overstated; private evidence or secrets are exposed; wallet/payment/signing/transaction/retry/action capability appears; public RPC failure crashes the page; a duplicate Vercel project is created or updated.
requiredReceipts: Adversarial deterministic API and receipt-classification test matrix plus full repository gates
Live fixed-source Base conformance receipt showing chain identity, source agreement behavior, and bounded failure semantics
Desktop and mobile browser proof of network pulse, valid lookup, invalid lookup, unavailable handling, and clean console/network
Canonical preview and production deployment receipts at the exact reviewed commit; proof that x402-canary-v2 was not updated
